explanation: A sidereal day is the average time taken by the first point of arise to cross the same meridian successively. The sidereal day is the time it takes for the Earth to complete one rotation about its axis with respect to the 'fixed' stars. By fixed we mean that we treat the stars if they were attached to an imaginary celestial sphere at a very large distance from the earth. subject: Civil Engineering Core
question: If the Froude number in open channel flow is less than 1.0, the flow is known as-
explanation: Subcritical flow – Subcritical occurs when the actual water depth is greater than critical depth. Subcritical flow is dominated by gravitational forces and behaves in a slow or stable way. It is defined as flow having a Froude number less than one. Supercritical flow – The flow at which depth of the channel is less than critical depth, velocity of flow is greater than critical velocity and slope of the channel is also greater than the critical slope is known as supercritical flow. It is defined as flow having a Froude number more than one. Critical flow – Critical flow occurs when the flow velocity in a channel equals the wave velocity generated by a disturbance or obstruction. In this condition the Froude number (Fr) = 1.

question: Weirs constructed on permeable foundation are likely to fail due to:

As the process of removal of soil particles goes on continuously, a depression if formed which extends backwards towards the upstream through the bottom of the foundation.
